image_description: A close-up view of a crocodile swimming in rippled water. Only the dorsal ridge, head, and part of the tail are visible above the surface. The skin appears textured with dark, bony scutes. The snout is visible on the right side, showing teeth and nostrils.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the head shows a tapered, V-shaped snout characteristic of crocodiles, distinct from the U-shape of alligators.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Several conical teeth are clearly visible protruding from the jawline, consistent with the interlocking nature described.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eyes are either submerged or obscured by the angle and water reflection; pupil shape and membrane cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostrils are visible at the very end of the snout, raised slightly above the water line.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible dorsal ridge confirms an elongated body structure covered in heavy armor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct, rough-textured scutes are visible in rows along the back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is dark grey/brown and the texture appears rough and bony.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral surface is completely submerged and not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All limbs are submerged and not visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the tail behind the head shows lateral compression and muscular definition consistent with a crocodile.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight inconsistency in water ripple physics where the snout breaks the surface; ripples appear somewhat painted rather than physically displaced.
Minor edge bleeding between the dark scutes and the blue water, likely due to depth-of-field simulation or generation blur.
